'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Greetings, soldier! Here's the situation. I ordered a batch of imported rifles from Mechanic for some clients. Personally, I still prefer our own weapons. Homegrown gear's always been closer to an old soldier's heart, you know?Anyway, it's an SR-25 fitted with a Hybrid 46 suppressor and a Schmidt & Bender PM II 1-8x24 scope. I need it properly field-tested. And don't waste your time shooting Scavs. I want to know how it performs against fighters who can actually shoot back. I'll issue you one. Put it through its paces, then come back and tell me what you think.}}
